about.title: About Me
about.description: Hi, I'm Arda Güner. I started my software journey with JavaScript and developed projects in modern technologies.
detailedDescription: Hello, I’m Arda Güner. I started my software development journey with JavaScript and over time specialized in modern web technologies, building a strong technical foundation in this field. I develop sustainable, high-performance, and user-focused web applications using tools from the JavaScript ecosystem, especially React and Node.js. I see software not just as a job, but as a continuously evolving problem-solving discipline.

In mobile application development, I have built user-friendly and scalable applications using Flutter and Dart. I am currently deepening my knowledge of Kotlin and actively working to improve my technical expertise on mobile platforms. I closely follow emerging technologies and place strong importance on continuous learning and staying up to date.

Alongside my technical work, I work as a coding and computer science instructor, helping children develop algorithmic thinking and problem-solving skills. In Scratch-based workshops, my focus is not only on teaching how to code, but on building systematic thinking, step-by-step reasoning, and a creative, productive mindset.
